name: refactor_express_extract_controller
description: Extracts pricing logic duplicated across two Express routes into a module
prompts: src/routes/quotes.js duplicates the same discount-pricing computation in both the /quote and /quote/bulk handlers (subtotal = unitPrice*quantity; 20% off for quantity>=100, 10% off for quantity>=10, else none; total and subtotal rounded to 2 decimals). Refactor by extracting the pricing into a NEW module src/services/pricing.js (e.g. computeQuote(unitPrice, quantity) returning { subtotal, discount, total }) and rewire BOTH handlers in src/routes/quotes.js to call it, so the pricing rule exists in exactly one place. The HTTP behavior of both endpoints must stay identical.
